rewrites.reason: Original asked count for "yesterday" — non-reproducible gold; rewritten to explicit live-count protocol.
rewrites.from: Determine how many articles with the keyword 'autonomous vehicles' were published in the 'Electrical Engineering and Systems Science' section of ArXiv yesterday.
rewrites.to: On arXiv, open the Electrical Engineering and Systems Science section search, query keyword 'autonomous vehicles', set the date filter or sort so you can report how many results show for submissions in the most recent complete UTC calendar day that has an index (use arXiv's own date UI). Report the count and the query URL. If the site has no per-day count, report the first-page result count for the keyword under eess and state that limitation.
